# DSFlashHub — DeepSeek V4 Flash & OpenClaw intelligence

> Independent hub tracking DeepSeek V4 Flash pricing, local deployment,
> OpenClaw integration, and model comparisons. Not affiliated with DeepSeek,
> OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, or the OpenClaw project.

## Facts (verified 2026-07-02)

- DeepSeek V4 Flash official API pricing: $0.14/M input, $0.028/M cache-hit input, $0.28/M output
- DeepSeek V4 Pro official API pricing: $1.74/M input, $0.145/M cache-hit input, $3.48/M output
- Model IDs: deepseek-v4-flash, deepseek-v4-pro (base URL https://api.deepseek.com, OpenAI-compatible)
- Legacy aliases deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner retire 2026-07-24 15:59 UTC, then route to deepseek-v4-flash
- V4 Flash architecture: 284B total / 13B active MoE, 1M-token context, 384K max output, MIT-licensed open weights
- V4 Pro architecture: 1.6T total / 49B active MoE, 1M-token context
- Local hardware tiers (community-reported): ~33 GB VRAM quantized GGUF, ~80 GB FP8 (1× H100), ~170 GB full precision (2× H200)
- Ollama library lists deepseek-v4-flash; OpenClaw one-liner: `ollama launch openclaw --model deepseek-v4-flash:cloud`
